business.title:
Four pillars,
expanding across business areas.
business.intro: We operate across four core business pillars, expanding from smartphone accessories into foods, technology, and B2B trade.

pillars.title: Smartphone Accessories Business
pillars.summary: A strong supply chain and in-house warehouse and logistics foundation supporting all device models.
pillars.body: We develop multiple in-house brands, including “3911”, around customer needs. Our integrated system covers planning, development, precision processing, inventory management at our Kobe warehouse, and logistics, enabling fast and stable delivery.

pillars.title: Foods & Global Specialty Products (国内産屋)
pillars.summary: Discovering agricultural products and specialties in Japan and abroad, then distributing them through our supply chain.
pillars.body: Since 2024, we have developed a new foods business. We discover valuable agricultural products and specialties in Japan and abroad, building a strong independent supply chain across Europe, Australia, China, and Taiwan.

pillars.title: AI & Systems Development
pillars.summary: Development and operation of software for office management, WMS, and e-commerce automation.
pillars.body: We develop and operate AI-enabled software for office management, WMS, and e-commerce automation. After validating it through our own operations, we plan to offer practical solutions that improve productivity across e-commerce and trade.

pillars.title: B2B Wholesale & Japan-China Trade
pillars.summary: Wholesale for major Kanto variety stores and two-way Japan-China trade and agency services.
pillars.body: Since 2026, we have expanded wholesale to major Kanto variety stores while promoting two-way Japan-China trade. We also support overseas brands entering Japan and Japanese brands expanding abroad as a general agency.

strengths.title: Why UO.
strengths.intro: UO Co., Ltd. is chosen because product support capability, quality, and customer care work together. We have built trust through broad model support, careful processing, and long-term relationships.

reasons.title: Support for a wide range of models
reasons.body: We maintain our lineup and processing system to support a wide range of smartphone models, connecting material sourcing to processing so we can respond to diverse needs.

reasons.title: Quality for custom-made products
reasons.body: Skilled craftspeople carefully finish each item by hand, including detailed camera-hole processing. We balance ease of use with dependable quality.

reasons.title: Thoughtful customer care
reasons.body: We include handwritten letters and small gifts at shipment, creating an experience beyond fulfillment. This care leads to repeat purchases and high ratings.

message.quote:
We want to bring a touch of the extraordinary
to the items people use every day.
paragraphs: From joining the e-commerce world in 2012 to launching a small online store in 2015, this idea has remained our unwavering starting point.
Even as technology makes e-commerce more efficient, we value human communication such as handwritten letters because customer smiles and better quality of life are the true purpose of our business.
values: Add the joy of choosing and a small sense of uniqueness to familiar products
Build long-term customer relationships beyond product delivery
Connect knowledge from real sales operations to future product development and business expansion.
